summary: XPeng Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing September and third-quarter 2026 vehicle delivery results. September deliveries totaled 41,256 units, up 5% month-over-month, with the L03 exceeding 10,000 units; third-quarter deliveries reached 118,390, up 15% sequentially. The release also notes the September 17 China launch of the G9L flagship SUV, XOS 6.3.0 rollout, and expansion of the self-operated charging network to over 4,000 stations. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is stated. Routine operational disclosure, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle.
